description: This is a test class for the EmployeePictureService in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, containing unit tests for methods such as getEmployeePictureDao, getAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber, getEmpPictureByEmpNumber, saveEmployeePicture, pictureSizeAdjust, and getEmpPictureETagByEmpNumber.
external_methods: Black-box methods of PHPUnit and PHP object mocking framework

classes.name: EmployeePictureServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the EmployeePictureService class, focusing on functionality like retrieving, saving employee pictures, size adjustment, and ETag generation.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Tests that the EmployeePictureService correctly returns an instance of EmployeePictureDao.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an employee picture if the user has access, based on employee number.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumberNotAllowed
methods.description: Ensures that access is denied (null returned) when the user does not have permission.

methods.name: testGetEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests fetching an employee picture directly by employee number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Tests saving an employee picture and returning the saved object.

methods.name: testPictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Verifies the image resizing logic for various image dimensions.

methods.name: getPictureSizeAdjustDataProvider
methods.description: Provides sample image data and expected resized dimensions for testing.

methods.name: testGetETagByEmpPicture
methods.description: Tests retrieving ETag for an employee's picture, ensuring proper caching behavior.
